name: raw_thread_crash
description: On arm, spawns a RAW std::thread (no xi::spawn_worker) that null-derefs. The per-thread SEH translator the host installs on dispatch threads does NOT cover an unmanaged plugin thread, so the access violation escapes to the host's top-level SetUnhandledExceptionFilter -> minidump + crash report. Used to prove the FE/BE in-process model still yields good post-mortem debug info when a plugin takes the backend down.
